title: Signed total Cech cochain morphism and its two axes
statement: Let $X$ be any scheme, $U_i$ any family of opens (not necessarily a cover), $F,G$ modules, and $D$ a computing resolution pairing [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data]. Write $A,B,C$ for the total Cech complexes of its left, right and target resolutions [def-sc-cup-cech-total]. There exists a cochain morphism $h:\operatorname{Tot}(A\otimes_{\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)}B)\to C$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. For all $p,q\ge0$, on tensors of alpha images of global cochains it equals alpha of $D.pair(p,q,\top)$; on tensors of beta images of coefficient Cech cochains it equals beta of their Alexander-Whitney cup cochain [def-sc-cech-cup-product]. These are equations of cochains, not of cohomology classes. No flasqueness, canonical comparison, cocycle or representative-existence hypothesis occurs.

proof.text: Obtain a total cochain morphism together with its defining signed formula on every tensor of included Cech row summands.
Apply the proved tensor-row-to-axis calculation to this same morphism and its normalization, obtaining both alpha and beta equations. Return the morphism and their conjunction.

theorem exists_cupCech_total_cochain_pairing {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u}
    (U : ι → X.Opens) {F G : X.Modules} (D : CupResolutionPairing F G) :
    let A := (cupCechDouble U D.left.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    let B := (cupCechDouble U D.right.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    let C := (cupCechDouble U D.target.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    ∃ h : HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)))
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ) ⟶ C,
      (∀ (p q : ℕ) (a : (cupSections D.left).X p) (b : (cupSections D.right).X q),
        h.f (p + q)
          (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)))
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p q (p + q) rfl
            (((cupCechAlpha U D.left).f p a) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
              ((cupCechAlpha U D.right).f q b))) =
        (cupCechAlpha U D.target).f (p + q) (D.pair p q ⊤ a b)) ∧
      (∀ (p q : ℕ)
        (a : ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat).X p)
        (b : ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj G.presheafModuleCat).X q),
        h.f (p + q)
          (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)))
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p q (p + q) rfl
            (((cupCechBeta U D.left).f p a) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
              ((cupCechBeta U D.right).f q b))) =
        (cupCechBeta U D.target).f (p + q) (cechCupCochain U F G p q a b))
